description: Deploy a digest-pinned CampusDesk release to the staging EC2 instance

ReleaseSha.description: Full Git commit SHA for the CampusDesk release

runCommand:
set -eu
umask 077

deployment_script='/usr/local/sbin/campusdesk-deploy'

if [ ! -f "$deployment_script" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'CampusDesk deployment script is missing.' >&2
  exit 1
fi

if [ ! -x "$deployment_script" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'CampusDesk deployment script is not executable.' >&2
  exit 1
fi

exec "$deployment_script" \
  --release-sha "$SSM_ReleaseSha" \
  --backend-image "$SSM_BackendImage" \
  --frontend-image "$SSM_FrontendImage"
